description: Ministry of National Policies & Economics Affairs - Order to appoint, 15.10.2017 as the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017 Operation date
reasoning: This gazette content announces the commencement date of the Foreign Exchange Act, No. 12 of 2017. It is a legal notice that brings a specific piece of legislation into operation, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification (Type 5) for new laws, acts, and regulations. While it names an individual (the Minister), the primary purpose is not about the person's appointment or their portfolio responsibilities, but rather the operationalization of a law.
